quests.title: Your Name Is On Backorder
quests.hook: NeuraTech has repossessed six residents' names. They are receiving mail addressed to PRODUCT. Find the original identity register beneath the Naming Office.
quests.a: Appeals receipt: originals require a witness, not a subscription.
quests.b: Witness record: the clerk witnessed the names BEFORE their sale.
quests.ending: The residents have their names back. One has chosen a new one: Refund.
quests.lore: A.S.P. lists a child's nickname as an unlicensed derivative work.

quests.title: The Right to Repair Yourself
quests.hook: Armatek recalled the workshop's prosthetic joints while people were wearing them. Find the mechanical release specification in the old returns facility.
quests.a: Service diagram: isolate power before disengaging the joint lock.
quests.b: Recall memo: the red cable is billing telemetry; the blue cable powers the lock.
quests.prompt: How should the joint lock be released?
quests.ending: The workshop can repair the joints now. Nobody has to mail in a knee.
quests.lore: Warranty void if the customer experiences stairs, joy, or weather.

quests.title: Dead Letter, Live Kidney
quests.hook: Vitalix sent transplant tissue to salvage. The cold boxes are still running, but their recipients are running out of time. Recover the routing manifest below the salvage office.
quests.a: Dispatch receipt: medical freight belongs on the cold chain.
quests.b: Address slip: the destination is a clinic, not the recycling furnace.
quests.prompt: Choose the destination for the manifest.
quests.ending: The clinic has the manifest and will collect its freight. The kidneys decline to tip.
quests.lore: CONTENTS: fragile. Do not fold, spindle, or promote to management.

quests.title: The Tide Is a Subscription
quests.hook: Newtown's waterfront pumps stop whenever the tide misses a payment. Explore the dry maintenance rooms beneath the quay and recover the public-service override.
quests.a: Pump schematic: the emergency bypass feeds the public drainage line.
quests.b: Contract appendix: flood safety remains mandatory during billing disputes.
quests.ending: The pumps now ignore unpaid tide invoices. The fish remain suspicious.
quests.lore: The dry galleries sit behind the seawall. This is a service facility, not an underwater walking tour.

quests.title: Eight Hours, Subject to Approval
quests.hook: NeuraTech sold the night shift's sleep credits twice. People are dreaming during forklift operation. Find the unedited sleep allocation record in the buried exchange.
quests.a: Medical record: eight hours of rest are allocated per worker.
quests.b: Sales ledger: duplicated credits were sold after the medical allocation.
quests.ending: The night shift can sleep again. The forklifts have requested the same benefit.
quests.lore: Premium nightmare package: now with an ad-free first scream.

quests.title: Heat Death of the Help Desk
quests.hook: The thaw house's backup boiler only heats unresolved complaints. Management closed every ticket. Recover the winter emergency charter beneath the frozen service annex.
quests.a: Safety notice: the winter charter overrides automated ticket closure.
quests.b: Temperature log: the annex is below the emergency threshold.
quests.ending: Backup heat is restored to the thaw house. Management has filed a complaint about warmth.
quests.lore: Your hypothermia is important to us. Current hold time: geological.
